factor_bounds: ratio clipped before exponent; no post-exponent clipping to [.5,2]

fixed.component_normalization: independent per-user max over eligible candidates after opportunity adjustment

fallback_ranking.fallback: cutoff-specific >=80% training popularity restricted to the applicable candidate pool
fallback_ranking.fusion: weighted sum of normalized scores; no score rounding
fallback_ranking.normalization: per-user max normalization over eligible candidate scores

fixed.zero_history: zero remains zero; pure repeat uses established popularity fallback

refit: only one eligible winner; no CSV if none qualifies
reuse: one shared AR fit and repeat50 map per split; reuse alpha=.5 factors across weight variants; exact prior duplicates reuse predictions when available

selection_rule.interpretation: practical conservative screening rule, not independent statistical confirmation
selection_rule.objective: largest minimum MAP@5 gain over the two splits
selection_rule.remaining_exact_cost_tie: retain Stage 9 rather than invent an additional selection rule
selection_rule.tie_break_1: fewer independent parameters changed from Stage 9; fusion weights are one independent parameter
selection_rule.tie_break_2: lower summed actual end-to-end computational cost across both splits, measured by fresh exact reproduction fits only for exact-tied finalists

uncertainty.caveat: overlapping periods, repeated selection, selection-unadjusted; not independent confirmation
uncertainty.method: paired-user percentile descriptive 95% intervals, all three cohorts
